items.a: Base64 encoding is a method of converting binary data (like images or documents) into a text string format. This is commonly used to embed images directly into HTML/CSS or transmit data securely without corruption.

items.q: Is my data secure when using this tool?
items.a: Yes! All encoding and decoding processes happen entirely locally in your browser. We never upload your text, images, or files to any external servers.

items.q: Can I convert images to Base64?
items.a: Absolutely. You can drop JPG, PNG, SVG, or other image files into the tool, and it will generate a Data URI format string that you can use directly in your web projects.
Because the tool runs in your browser, performance is dependent on your device. Very large files might take a moment to encode, but standard images and text strings process instantly.
